* 3. ExecutionGraph
:PROPERTIES:
:CUSTOM_ID: storage/ExecutionGraph
:FILE: src/graphden/storage/protocol/core.clj

Defines ~resolve-execution-graph~: given a root function ID, return the [[file:glossary.org::#term/reachable-graph][reachable graph]] and its indexes. Generic and PostgreSQL implementations follow below. This is a separate API from the executor's full-registry rebuild, which currently queries the graph entity tables through ~StorageCRUD~.

Traverses the [[file:glossary.org::#term/reachable-graph][reachable graph]] [[file:glossary.org::#term/reachable-graph][breadth first]] ([[file:glossary.org::#term/reachable-graph][BFS]]): visit the current functions, collect their references, then visit previously unseen targets. :PROPERTIES:
:CUSTOM_ID: storage/resolve-execution-graph
:FILE: src/graphden/storage/protocol/generic_graph.clj
:LINE: 36
:MINS: 1.5

Implements reachable-graph resolution using generic row loaders and [[file:glossary.org::#term/reachable-graph][breadth-first]] traversal. It works with any ~StorageCRUD~ backend, but the number of database calls grows with the visited graph. The PostgreSQL-specific resolver below batches those reads.

Implements the storage [[file:glossary.org::#term/protocol][protocols]] for PostgreSQL, mostly by delegating each method to a helper. Its ~ExecutionGraph~ implementation selects the optimized PostgreSQL resolver rather than the generic traversal. Read the [[file:glossary.org::#term/protocol][protocol]] headings to distinguish lifecycle, row operations, constraints, and graph resolution.

* 14. do-initialize
:PROPERTIES:
:CUSTOM_ID: storage/do-initialize
:FILE: src/graphden/storage/postgres/migration.clj
:LINE: 286
:MINS: 2.9
:END:

Compares the declared schema with stored metadata and applies the required database changes in a transaction. A transaction-scoped [[file:glossary.org::#term/advisory-lock][advisory lock]] is acquired before reading metadata, so concurrent process startups do not plan migrations against the same outdated state. See [[file:../../../docs/OPERATIONS.md][operations]].

- source :: [[file:../../../src/graphden/storage/postgres/migration.clj::(defn do-initialize][src/graphden/storage/postgres/migration.clj:286]]

* 17. make-emitter
:PROPERTIES:
:CUSTOM_ID: storage/make-emitter
:FILE: src/graphden/storage/postgres/notify.clj
:LINE: 312
:MINS: 2.4
:END:

Creates the write-notification sender. After a write, it sends ~pg_notify~ through the pooled DataSource so other processes can refresh their state promptly. Notification failure does not undo the stored write; [[file:glossary.org::#term/reconciliation][reconciliation]] remains responsible for recovering current state.

- source :: [[file:../../../src/graphden/storage/postgres/notify.clj::(defn make-emitter][src/graphden/storage/postgres/notify.clj:312]]

* 18. create-listener
:PROPERTIES:
:CUSTOM_ID: storage/create-listener
:FILE: src/graphden/storage/postgres/notify.clj
:LINE: 252
:MINS: 2.2
:END:

Receives ~graphden_events~ on a dedicated PostgreSQL connection because ~LISTEN~ belongs to a connection session. A background thread polls and reconnects with increasing delays after failures. Callback failures are isolated; branch [[file:glossary.org::#term/invalidation][invalidation]], service [[file:glossary.org::#term/reconciliation][reconciliation]], and browser update notifications subscribe here.

- source :: [[file:../../../src/graphden/storage/postgres/notify.clj::(defn create-listener][src/graphden/storage/postgres/notify.clj:252]]
